# Fiyinfoluwa Adeleke

> Legal and Regulatory Leadership | Technology, Digital Regulation and Governance

Fiyinfoluwa Adeleke is a senior legal and regulatory executive working across technology, digital regulation and governance. His experience spans contested regulatory proceedings, regulatory policy, governance design, technology implementation and incident response across international businesses in EMEA, APAC and Latin America.

## Current role

- KEATTEL Limited - Managing Director | Principal, Regulatory Advisory (October 2026 to present). Lead regulatory advisory at a specialist regulatory and compliance advisory firm focused on privacy, AI, cybersecurity and digital resilience.

## Previous roles

- Yahoo (Dublin) - Senior Director, Associate General Counsel, Head of International Privacy (2022 to September 2026); Director, Assistant General Counsel, Global Privacy (2021 to 2022). Employment transferred to Yahoo International following the 2025 separation of Yahoo's EMEA business.
- Hertz International (Dublin) - Director, Senior Privacy Counsel and Head of Privacy (2017 to 2021).
- EQUINITI (Amsterdam) - KYC/AML Analyst, then Lead Analyst, then Quality Lead, Products and Services (2014 to 2017).
- G. Elias & Co., Solicitors and Advocates (Lagos) - Associate, Corporate and Commercial (2011 to 2013).

## Capabilities

### Regulatory Strategy, Investigations, Inquiries and Engagement

- Regulatory engagement and enforcement
- Regulatory strategy and public policy

### Legal and Regulatory Compliance Programme Building and Implementation

- Governance and programme building
- AI governance and algorithmic accountability

### Operational Risk, Trust, Safety and Incident Response

- Trust, safety and law enforcement
- Information security, incident and breach response

### Cross-cutting

- Legal and regulatory leadership
- Technology implementation

## Research

- PhD candidate (part-time), Law, UCD Sutherland School of Law. Research on regulating algorithmic credit scoring and protecting data subjects' rights in the EU. Supervisor: Dr TJ McIntyre. Ongoing doctoral research, not a completed doctorate.

## Admissions and credentials

- Admitted to practise in Ireland (Solicitor), England and Wales (Solicitor), Nigeria (Barrister and Solicitor).
- IAPP Fellow of Information Privacy (FIP); CIPM, CIPP/E, CDPSE, GRCP; Lean Six Sigma Green Belt.
- Education: PhD candidate (part-time) and LLM, University College Dublin; LLM, Duisenberg School of Finance, University of Amsterdam; BL, Nigerian Law School; LLB, Obafemi Awolowo University.
